draft.subject: Robotics Electrical Engineering Intern | Justin Mascarenhas
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I applied for the Robotics Electrical Engineering Intern role at RoboForce and wanted to reach out, since you lead structures on the hardware side and would likely know how the electrical and firmware team is staffing up.

My background is hands on embedded work. I have programmed STM32 peripherals in bare metal C, working directly with timers, ADC, and I2C, and I fabricated custom PCBs in Eagle while implementing UART and I2C sensor communication with closed loop feedback on a locomotive robot.

If you have a few minutes, I would appreciate a short call to talk through what the team looks for in this role, or point me toward whoever runs the hiring process for it.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
